m.d: You use us to talk or write about yourself and other people together with you.
You use us to refer to yourself and other people together with you.
m.e: It's OK for you guys, but it's different for us women.

m.d: A way to apply something; an application.
m.e: They put it to good use.

m.d: A time when something is applied.
m.e: This battery will last for 2000 uses.

m.d: To treat as unimportant, abuse; used about people.
m.e: She only uses him to do the house chores.

m.d: You use usually to talk about what happens most of the time.
m.e: He usually takes a long time to get ready, but he can be fast too.

m.d: something that is usual happens often
m.e: It is usual for me to read the newspaper in the morning.

m.d: If something is useless, it has no use.
Good for a purpose. If something is useful it can be used for something.
A user is someone who uses something.
A user is someone with an account and username that lets them log in to a computer and do things on the computer.
An usher is a person who escorts people to their seats.
If you usher a person, you guide them somewhere.
The way or the amount of using; use.
m.e: I learnt the usage of some verbs while studying the language.

m.d: If something is usable, then it can be used.
